result.description:
Randstad is proud to partner with Queensland Rail (QR) on a major recruitment drive to source engineering professionals. As part of this major recruitment drive, we are looking to identify an experienced Principal Telecommunications Network Engineer - ETCS for the ETCS Sequence Alliance (Embedded) division.  
  QR has a current project pipeline of over A$15 billion, and this is expected to grow exponentially in the build-up to the 2032 Brisbane Olympic and Paralympic Games.. As a result of this significant investment, the need to secure in-house technical and engineering resources is paramount to support their critical technology rollouts. This includes ensuring that European Train Control Systems (ETCS) telecommunications networks are technically robust and compliant across the network.  
  What You'll Do  
  The Principal Telecommunications Network Engineer - ETCS will provide specialist engineering services and technical leadership to project-based teams. You will be responsible for ensuring that ETCS telecommunications networks are technically robust, commercially optimized, and seamlessly integrated.  
 
  Drive Engineering Excellence  : Monitor and influence ETCS Cross River Rail (CRR) telecommunications data system projects, ensuring peak performance levels are achieved at competitive costs. You will ensure that integration into the QR data network never compromises reliability, availability, or maintainability.  
  Coach & Inspire:   Lead the facilitation of technical training and competency development for telecommunications office and field staff, ensuring a powerful capability uplift and compliance across teams.  
  Innovate & Optimize  : Ensure technical standards and procedures are meticulously documented and applied in accordance with Queensland Rail Quality Assurance and Improvement Principles.  
  Thought Leader  : Provide strategic technical leadership and advice to business groups, technical staff, and external stakeholders, ensuring complex network solutions align perfectly with QR's operational requirements.  
   Uphold Integrity : Champion strict compliance with professional engineering practices, Queensland Rail standards, and all corporate legal and safety obligations.  
 
  What We Are Looking For  
  We are looking for a strong implementor in the network engineering space who brings a deep understanding of data communications, commercial acumen, and high-level stakeholder management skills.  
 
  Qualifications  : A Bachelor of Engineering (Electrical & Electronic)   AND   ideally   current Registered Professional Engineer Queensland (RPEQ) status   or   have the necessary qualifications and experience to attain it. IE: have CEng or Professional Engineer status with Engineers Australia.  
  Network Telecoms Experience:   Extensive knowledge of LAN/WAN data communications, and physical network security applicable to a railway network. You must bring high-level skills in the design, system configuration, construction, auditing, commissioning, integration, and technical support of telecommunications network systems. Candidates would ideally come from a client or contractor background and have strong implementation experience.  
  Analytical & Technical Depth:   Extensive knowledge of telecommunications performance and integration principles, combined with strong analytical and problem-solving skills to keep ETCS CRR projects operationally effective.  
  Commercial Acumen:   A proven track record of delivering business-focused technical and professional network solutions that bring tangible commercial value to the business.  
  Soft Skills & Influence  : High levels of interpersonal, influencing, and negotiation skills.  
 
  Queensland Rail is a progressive organisation that promotes a flexible working environment to allow for a healthy work-life balance. It actively prioritizes the development of its people in a supportive, diverse, and inclusive work culture.  
  QR offers the following benefits:  
 
  Competitive remuneration packages  
  Comprehensive relocation assistance (if applicable)  
  A long-term consistent pipeline of work, offering job security and stellar opportunities for technical and professional development  
 
  Why choose Queensland to live and work?  
  More people from within Australia are migrating to Queensland than to any other state! It's hard not to see why, with a fantastic climate, affordable housing, stunning beaches, national parks, and one of the great wonders of the world - The Great Barrier Reef, Queensland has it all.  
  How to apply  
  If you want to grasp this life changing opportunity then please click apply.   For more information visit our landing page www.randstad.com.au/rail-australia/  

 At Randstad, we are passionate about providing equal employment opportunities and embracing diversity to the benefit of all. We actively encourage applications from any background. 
   
    Please  click here  to apply.

ICM Agribusiness (Peechelba Beef) are currently looking to recruit experienced and qualified Plant Operator to join their team in Peechelba VIC.

The successful candidate will need to undertake and possess:

-  Preparing and positioning plant for operation 
-  Operating tractor drawn and self-propelled plant to plough land and sow, fertilise, cultivate and harvest crops, and avoid damaging crops. 
-  Calibrating and monitoring plant performance, including adjusting speed, height and depth of implements as well as distribution or collection rates as needed. 
-  Operating plant to conduct farm and feedlot operations
-  Identify the appropriate machine for the task being performed.
-  Keeping production and work records and writing reports
-  Servicing plant and performing minor repairs
-  Conduct pre-start checks on all machinery and ensure all machinery is running efficiently.
-  Operate machinery efficiently to remove manure from pens, around the fertiliser processing area and out on the farm. 
-  Operate machinery efficiently within the Feeds area, loading trucks, sorting commodities and processing rations. 
-  Assist with the implementation of internal policies and procedures to ensure that efficient feeding is conducted on a day-to-day basis.
-  Use the appropriate attachments for the task such as buckets, hay forks, bunk sweep and bunk blower attachments.
-  Use the appropriate plant to turn windrows in the manure composting area and throughout the drying process including screening fertiliser to ensure impurities are removed. 
-  Load trucks with processed fertiliser for spreading on the farm and crop paddocks or to sell to external farmers for their crop paddocks or the home gardener. 
-  Load trucks with the appropriate ration and amount of ration for each load to feed all cattle on the farm/feedlot.
-  Ensure a high standard of presentation is maintained around the farm/feedlot.
-  Ensuring all plant (stationary or moving) are presented as clean as reasonably possible.  
-  Maximise the sustainable return from the land, capital, commodity, plant, equipment and water assets used with that department.
-  To follow all required Work Health and Safety policies and procedures while operating plant and equipment. 


Required Experience, Skills and Qualifications

-  One year of experience operating large broadacre farming machinery and/or earth moving equipment.
-  Demonstrated ability to work as part of a team. 
-  Demonstrated ability to work with minimal supervision when required.
-  An ability to follow set protocols and ensure compliance with relevant animal welfare, safety, and QA requirements.

Salary range is $69,000-$80,000pa commensurate with experience

Fulltime Positions available
 
Applications open on 23rd July 2026 and closes on 23rd August 2026

If you are interested in this role APPLY now. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted

result.description:
Safety Advisor / Occupational Health and Safety Advisor – Full-Time
Location: Welshpool, Western Australia 6106
Employment Type: Full-Time
Salary: $100,000 – $130,000 per annum (depending on skills and experience)

MINPROVISE INTERNATIONAL PTY LTD is a leading total solutions provider delivering specialist maintenance and shutdown services, engineering, fabrication, project services, and sustaining capital works. We also provide a comprehensive range of equipment and products, supporting the mining, oil & gas, and construction industries across Australia and internationally.

We are currently seeking an experienced and motivated Safety Advisor / Occupational Health and Safety Advisor to join our growing team on a full-time basis.

About the Role
As a Safety Advisor / Occupational Health and Safety Advisor, you will be responsible for supporting the implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of workplace health and safety systems across mining, engineering, maintenance, fabrication, and industrial projects. You will work closely with project managers, supervisors, employees, and contractors to ensure compliance with legislation, company policies, and client safety requirements.

Key Responsibilities
•	Implement, maintain, and monitor workplace health and safety systems, policies, and procedures.
•	Provide advice and guidance to management, supervisors, and employees on occupational health and safety matters.
•	Conduct workplace inspections, audits, risk assessments, and safety observations.
•	Identify workplace hazards and recommend appropriate control measures to minimise risks.
•	Assist with incident investigations, reporting, root cause analysis, and corrective actions.
•	Develop, review, and maintain safety documentation, including SWMS, JSA, risk assessments, and safety reports.
•	Monitor compliance with WHS legislation, Australian Standards, client requirements, and company procedures.
•	Deliver safety inductions, toolbox talks, and training sessions to employees and contractors.
•	Promote a strong safety culture and encourage continuous improvement in workplace practices.
•	Assist project teams with safety planning, mobilisation requirements, and compliance documentation.
•	Maintain safety records, registers, inspection reports, and incident databases.
•	Liaise with clients, contractors, and regulatory bodies regarding health and safety matters where required.
•	Ensure compliance with workplace health, safety, environmental, and quality management systems.

Skills and Experience
•	Minimum 1-2 years of full-time experience as a Safety Advisor, Occupational Health and Safety Advisor, or similar WHS role.
•	Relevant qualification in Occupational Health and Safety, Workplace Health and Safety, or a related discipline.
•	Strong knowledge of Australian WHS legislation, safety management systems, and risk management principles.
•	Experience working within mining, construction, engineering, maintenance, or industrial environments is highly regarded.
•	Ability to conduct workplace inspections, audits, investigations, and safety training.
•	Strong communication, consultation, and problem-solving skills.
•	Excellent attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.
•	Ability to work independently and collaboratively with project teams.
•	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and safety management systems.

What We Offer
•	Full-time, permanent employment.
•	Competitive salary of $100,000 – $130,000 per annum.
•	Opportunities to work on major mining, shutdown, engineering, and industrial projects.
•	Ongoing professional development and career progression.
•	Supportive team environment with long-term career opportunities.

Next Gen Talent
Company: Dharma Bhakti Group Pty Ltd t/a Sunrise Custom Homes
Position Title: Architectural Draftsperson
Location: Adelaide, South Australia, 3061
Salary: AUD 79,500 to 82,000 + Super

About the Business:
Sunrise Custom Homes are Adelaide’s trusted custom home builders. They specialise in fully customisable homes and work closely with each client to bring their vision to life. Whether you’re building your first home or creating an investment property, their expertise and passion ensure your dream becomes a reality.

About the Role:
They are seeking a skilled and motivated Architectural Draftsperson to join their team. This hands-on position requires strong technical capability in drafting and documentation, along with a commitment to accuracy and high-quality design outcomes. The ideal candidate will be proficient in industry-standard drafting software and confident in reading, interpreting, and producing detailed architectural drawings. You’ll play a key role in transforming concepts into build-ready documentation, contributing directly to the delivery of custom homes.

Minimum Requirements:
Diploma or Advanced Diploma in Building Design, Architectural Drafting, Building Design Technology or a related discipline, or an equivalent qualification.
Minimum 1–3 years' experience in architectural drafting or building design within Australian residential construction projects.

Key Responsibilities:
Prepare detailed architectural drawings, construction documentation and working drawings for residential dwellings, custom homes, renovations and property development projects using CAD and Revit software.
Develop concept drawings, floor plans, elevations, sections and detailed construction documentation based on client requirements, architectural designs and engineering specifications.
Produce accurate working drawings in accordance with the National Construction Code (NCC), relevant Australian Standards and local council planning requirements.
Prepare detailed documentation including structural layouts, site plans, floor plans, roof plans, drainage layouts, service layouts and construction details for residential projects.
Modify and customise existing home designs and floor plans to suit client preferences, site conditions, budget requirements and regulatory requirements.
Coordinate drawings and documentation with architects, engineers, building designers, surveyors, certifiers, energy assessors, consultants, builders and project managers to ensure design accuracy and project consistency.
Liaise with clients and project stakeholders to gather project information and translate design concepts into accurate technical drawings.
Prepare documentation required for Development Applications (DA), Planning Approvals, Building Approvals, Council submissions and other statutory approval processes.
Review architectural, structural and engineering drawings to identify inconsistencies, drafting errors and construction issues prior to project commencement.
Amend, revise and update drawings based on client feedback, council requirements, consultant recommendations, engineering input and design changes throughout the design and construction process.
Assist with project coordination, planning approvals and construction documentation throughout all stages of residential projects.
Prepare schedules for doors, windows, finishes, fixtures and fittings to support construction documentation and procurement.
Assist in preparing material quantities, preliminary cost estimates and design documentation for tendering and project planning purposes.
Conduct site measurements and inspections where required to verify existing conditions and ensure drafting accuracy for renovations, custom homes and development projects.
Collaborate with construction supervisors, site teams and project managers to resolve design-related queries during construction and issue updated documentation where required.
Maintain accurate electronic records of drawings, revisions, project documentation and version control using the company's document management systems.
Research and apply current building regulations, planning policies, residential construction methods and sustainable design principles to ensure ongoing compliance and improve project outcomes.

Essential Skills
Proficient in CAD and Revit software for producing accurate architectural drawings and construction documentation.
Strong understanding of residential construction methods, detailing, building systems and construction processes.
Thorough knowledge of the National Construction Code (NCC), Australian Standards and local council planning requirements.
Ability to interpret architectural drawings, engineering plans, technical specifications and consultant documentation.
Strong attention to detail with the ability to prepare accurate, compliant and high-quality documentation.
Excellent communication and coordination skills with the ability to work effectively with clients, engineers, consultants, builders, site teams and project managers.
Strong organisational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Sound problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and resolve drafting and design issues throughout project delivery.

How to Apply:
To apply for this position, please email your resume to info@nextgentalent.com.au. Please note that only short-listed candidates will be contacted, and your application will be treated as strictly confidential

Main Activities
Designing, coding, testing and installing applications programs up to 75% of the time, either in one major program or a range of programs across multiple platforms.
Preparing and maintaining systems and program documentation.
Assisting in the analysis and design of applications programs and databases.
Modifying and troubleshooting applications programs.
Liaising with users.

Core responsibilities:
Development:
· Work with Business Analysts to analyse business processes, procedures and user requirements in order to establish system requirements.
· Participate in system design including production of system and program documentation as well as ongoing maintenance
· Develop solutions and specifications so that agreed requirements can be converted into functional systems
· Develop, program and code technology applications software solutions to meet agreed specifications. Improve, enhance and correct systems as necessary
· Achieve key Systems Development Life Cycle stages in terms of quantity, timing and quality of all aspects of work allocated
· Ensure all work is carried out in accordance with required standards, methods and procedures
Support:
· Create development and support documentation and provide advice regarding applications to enable support function to work pro-actively
· Contribute to conduct of post implementation reviews to assess the effectiveness of the testing solution provided
· Contribute to the review and redesign of processes or procedures, on an ongoing basis, to deliver improved team productivity or efficiency
· Provide key support on fail and fix for assigned application/s
Testing:
· Undertake complex testing activities in relation to software solutions ensuring these meet agreed specifications
· Develop comprehensive test scripts and scenarios based on testing plan in accordance with standard procedures and templates
· Execute test cases, check and document results to ensure the systems technical, functional and non-functional (e.g. elementary load testing) requirements are met
· Contribute to testing of any actions taken to rectify users# problems to ensure user and system requirements are met and that changes integrate with production system
· Make initial diagnosis of problems, for a system or sub-system or apply known solutions, including documenting problems, progress checking, and escalation to ensure resolution
Additional responsibilities:
· Appropriately use progress/tracking tools and complete administration activities
· Test, launch and help train users in new systems
· Work with business users (in conjunction with Business Analysts) to clarify requirements, resolve issues
· Document systems and produce desk procedures for ongoing user use. End user support/ 2nd level Help Desk
· Contribute to maintaining operating environments to enable testing which reflects user environments
· May undertake evaluation and quality reviews of system development processes and practices and thereby contribute to the overall effectiveness of the function/ team.

Salary $80K - $95K
